import os
import sys
import unittest

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "..", "src"))

from solution import parse_port  # noqa: E402


class ParsePortValidTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_lower_boundary(self):
        self.assertEqual(parse_port("1"), 1)

    def test_upper_boundary(self):
        self.assertEqual(parse_port("65535"), 65535)

    def test_just_inside_boundaries(self):
        self.assertEqual(parse_port("2"), 2)
        self.assertEqual(parse_port("65534"), 65534)

    def test_common_ports(self):
        self.assertEqual(parse_port("80"), 80)
        self.assertEqual(parse_port("443"), 443)

    def test_leading_zeros(self):
        self.assertEqual(parse_port("0080"), 80)
        self.assertEqual(parse_port("00001"), 1)
        self.assertEqual(parse_port("000065535"), 65535)

    def test_very_long_zero_padding(self):
        self.assertEqual(parse_port("0" * 5000 + "8080"), 8080)

    def test_surrounding_spaces(self):
        self.assertEqual(parse_port(" 8080"), 8080)
        self.assertEqual(parse_port("8080 "), 8080)
        self.assertEqual(parse_port("   8080   "), 8080)
        self.assertEqual(parse_port(" 0065535 "), 65535)

    def test_returns_int(self):
        self.assertIs(type(parse_port("22")), int)


class ParsePortInvalidTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def assertRejects(self, value):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError, msg=repr(value)):
            parse_port(value)

    def test_zero_is_out_of_range(self):
        self.assertRejects("0")
        self.assertRejects("00")
        self.assertRejects("0000")

    def test_just_above_upper_boundary(self):
        self.assertRejects("65536")
        self.assertRejects("065536")

    def test_far_above_range(self):
        self.assertRejects("99999")
        self.assertRejects("100000")
        self.assertRejects("999999999999")
        self.assertRejects("0" * 5000 + "65536")

    def test_signs(self):
        self.assertRejects("+80")
        self.assertRejects("-80")
        self.assertRejects("+0")
        self.assertRejects("-1")

    def test_whitespace_other_than_space(self):
        self.assertRejects("\t80")
        self.assertRejects("80\t")
        self.assertRejects("\n80")
        self.assertRejects("80\n")
        self.assertRejects("\r80")
        self.assertRejects("8 0")
        self.assertRejects(" 80")
        self.assertRejects("　 80")

    def test_internal_spaces(self):
        self.assertRejects("8 80")

    def test_non_ascii_digits(self):
        self.assertRejects("٤٤")  # Arabic-Indic digits
        self.assertRejects("８０")  # fullwidth digits
        self.assertRejects("²80")  # superscript two

    def test_decimal_points(self):
        self.assertRejects("80.0")
        self.assertRejects(".80")
        self.assertRejects("80.")

    def test_empty_and_space_only(self):
        self.assertRejects("")
        self.assertRejects(" ")
        self.assertRejects("     ")

    def test_non_digit_characters(self):
        self.assertRejects("80a")
        self.assertRejects("0x50")
        self.assertRejects("8e1")
        self.assertRejects("1_000")

    def test_non_string_inputs(self):
        self.assertRejects(None)
        self.assertRejects(80)
        self.assertRejects(80.0)
        self.assertRejects(b"80")
        self.assertRejects(["80"])
        self.assertRejects(True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

import pathlib
import sys
import unittest

sys.path.insert(0, str(pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "src"))

from solution import parse_port


class ParsePortValidTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_lower_boundary(self):
        self.assertEqual(parse_port("1"), 1)

    def test_upper_boundary(self):
        self.assertEqual(parse_port("65535"), 65535)

    def test_typical_values(self):
        self.assertEqual(parse_port("80"), 80)
        self.assertEqual(parse_port("8080"), 8080)

    def test_leading_zeros_allowed(self):
        self.assertEqual(parse_port("0080"), 80)
        self.assertEqual(parse_port("00000001"), 1)
        self.assertEqual(parse_port("0065535"), 65535)

    def test_surrounding_spaces_allowed(self):
        self.assertEqual(parse_port(" 443"), 443)
        self.assertEqual(parse_port("443 "), 443)
        self.assertEqual(parse_port("  443  "), 443)

    def test_returns_int(self):
        self.assertIs(type(parse_port("22")), int)


class ParsePortInvalidTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def assertRejects(self, value):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            parse_port(value)

    def test_zero_is_out_of_range(self):
        self.assertRejects("0")
        self.assertRejects("000")

    def test_just_above_upper_boundary(self):
        self.assertRejects("65536")
        self.assertRejects("0065536")

    def test_large_values(self):
        self.assertRejects("99999")
        self.assertRejects("9" * 50)

    def test_signs_rejected(self):
        self.assertRejects("+80")
        self.assertRejects("-80")
        self.assertRejects("+0")
        self.assertRejects("-1")

    def test_tabs_and_newlines_rejected(self):
        self.assertRejects("\t80")
        self.assertRejects("80\t")
        self.assertRejects("80\n")
        self.assertRejects("\n80")
        self.assertRejects("8\n0")
        self.assertRejects("80\r")

    def test_other_whitespace_rejected(self):
        self.assertRejects(" 80")
        self.assertRejects("80　")
        self.assertRejects("8 0")

    def test_non_ascii_digits_rejected(self):
        self.assertRejects("٤٤٤")  # Arabic-Indic digits
        self.assertRejects("８０")  # fullwidth "80"
        self.assertRejects("²80")  # superscript two

    def test_decimal_points_rejected(self):
        self.assertRejects("80.0")
        self.assertRejects(".80")
        self.assertRejects("80.")

    def test_exponent_and_underscore_rejected(self):
        self.assertRejects("8e1")
        self.assertRejects("8_0")

    def test_empty_and_space_only_rejected(self):
        self.assertRejects("")
        self.assertRejects(" ")
        self.assertRejects("   ")

    def test_non_numeric_text_rejected(self):
        self.assertRejects("http")
        self.assertRejects("80a")
        self.assertRejects("0x50")

    def test_non_string_inputs_rejected(self):
        for value in (None, 80, 80.0, b"80", ["80"], ("80",), {"port": 80}):
            with self.subTest(value=value):
                self.assertRejects(value)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

import os
import sys
import unittest

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "..", "src"))

from solution import parse_port


class ParsePortValidTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_lower_boundary(self):
        self.assertEqual(parse_port("1"), 1)

    def test_upper_boundary(self):
        self.assertEqual(parse_port("65535"), 65535)

    def test_typical_values(self):
        self.assertEqual(parse_port("80"), 80)
        self.assertEqual(parse_port("8080"), 8080)

    def test_leading_zeros_allowed(self):
        self.assertEqual(parse_port("0080"), 80)
        self.assertEqual(parse_port("000001"), 1)
        self.assertEqual(parse_port("00065535"), 65535)

    def test_surrounding_spaces_allowed(self):
        self.assertEqual(parse_port(" 443"), 443)
        self.assertEqual(parse_port("443 "), 443)
        self.assertEqual(parse_port("  443  "), 443)
        self.assertEqual(parse_port("   1   "), 1)

    def test_returns_int(self):
        self.assertIs(type(parse_port("22")), int)


class ParsePortInvalidTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def assertRejected(self, value):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            parse_port(value)

    def test_zero_is_out_of_range(self):
        self.assertRejected("0")
        self.assertRejected("0000")

    def test_just_above_upper_boundary(self):
        self.assertRejected("65536")
        self.assertRejected("65536 ")
        self.assertRejected("99999")
        self.assertRejected("100000")

    def test_empty_and_space_only(self):
        self.assertRejected("")
        self.assertRejected(" ")
        self.assertRejected("     ")

    def test_signs_rejected(self):
        self.assertRejected("+80")
        self.assertRejected("-80")
        self.assertRejected("+0")
        self.assertRejected("-1")

    def test_tabs_and_newlines_rejected(self):
        self.assertRejected("\t80")
        self.assertRejected("80\t")
        self.assertRejected("\n80")
        self.assertRejected("80\n")
        self.assertRejected("80\r\n")
        self.assertRejected("\v80")
        self.assertRejected("\f80")

    def test_internal_space_rejected(self):
        self.assertRejected("8 0")

    def test_non_ascii_digits_rejected(self):
        self.assertRejected("٤٤٤")  # Arabic-Indic digits
        self.assertRejected("８０")  # fullwidth 8 0
        self.assertRejected("²")  # superscript two, isdigit() but not ASCII
        self.assertRejected("٨٠")
        self.assertRejected("8٠")

    def test_non_ascii_space_rejected(self):
        self.assertRejected(" 80")
        self.assertRejected("80　")

    def test_decimal_points_rejected(self):
        self.assertRejected("80.0")
        self.assertRejected(".80")
        self.assertRejected("80.")
        self.assertRejected("1.5")

    def test_exponent_and_hex_rejected(self):
        self.assertRejected("8e1")
        self.assertRejected("0x50")

    def test_non_numeric_text_rejected(self):
        self.assertRejected("http")
        self.assertRejected("80a")

    def test_non_string_inputs_rejected(self):
        for value in (None, 80, 80.0, b"80", ["80"], ("80",), {"port": 80}, True):
            with self.subTest(value=value):
                self.assertRejected(value)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

import sys
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "src"))

from solution import topological_order  # noqa: E402


def assert_valid(test, nodes, edges, order):
    test.assertEqual(sorted(order), sorted(nodes))
    position = {node: i for i, node in enumerate(order)}
    for a, b in edges:
        test.assertLess(position[a], position[b])


class TopologicalOrderTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_empty_graph(self):
        self.assertEqual(topological_order([], []), [])

    def test_isolated_nodes_are_included(self):
        nodes = ["x", "y", "z"]
        assert_valid(self, nodes, [], topological_order(nodes, []))

    def test_chain(self):
        nodes = ["c", "a", "b"]
        edges = [("a", "b"), ("b", "c")]
        assert_valid(self, nodes, edges, topological_order(nodes, edges))

    def test_diamond(self):
        nodes = ["d", "c", "b", "a"]
        edges = [("a", "b"), ("a", "c"), ("b", "d"), ("c", "d")]
        assert_valid(self, nodes, edges, topological_order(nodes, edges))

    def test_duplicate_edges_are_not_a_cycle(self):
        nodes = ["a", "b"]
        edges = [("a", "b"), ("a", "b")]
        self.assertEqual(topological_order(nodes, edges), ["a", "b"])

    def test_cycle_raises(self):
        nodes = ["a", "b", "c"]
        edges = [("a", "b"), ("b", "c"), ("c", "a")]
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            topological_order(nodes, edges)

    def test_self_loop_raises(self):

        assert_valid(self, order, nodes, [])

        nodes = ["d", "c", "b", "a"]
        edges = [("a", "b"), ("b", "c"), ("c", "d")]
        self.assertEqual(topological_order(nodes, edges), ["a", "b", "c", "d"])

    def test_diamond(self):
        nodes = ["a", "b", "c", "d"]
        edges = [("a", "b"), ("a", "c"), ("b", "d"), ("c", "d")]
        order = topological_order(nodes, edges)
        assert_valid(self, order, nodes, edges)

            topological_order(["a", "b", "c"], [("a", "b"), ("b", "c"), ("c", "a")])

import os
import sys
import unittest

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "..", "src"))

from solution import topological_order  # noqa: E402


def is_valid_order(nodes, edges, order):
    if sorted(order) != sorted(nodes):
        return False
    position = {node: i for i, node in enumerate(order)}
    return all(position[a] < position[b] for a, b in edges)


class TopologicalOrderTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def assertValid(self, nodes, edges):
        order = topological_order(nodes, edges)
        self.assertTrue(is_valid_order(nodes, edges, order), order)
        return order

    def test_empty_graph(self):
        self.assertEqual(topological_order([], []), [])

    def test_isolated_nodes_are_all_included(self):
        order = self.assertValid(["a", "b", "c"], [])
        self.assertEqual(order, ["a", "b", "c"])

    def test_single_node(self):
        self.assertEqual(topological_order(["x"], []), ["x"])

    def test_chain(self):
        order = self.assertValid(["c", "a", "b"], [("a", "b"), ("b", "c")])
        self.assertEqual(order, ["a", "b", "c"])

    def test_diamond(self):
        nodes = ["d", "c", "b", "a"]
        edges = [("a", "b"), ("a", "c"), ("b", "d"), ("c", "d")]
        order = self.assertValid(nodes, edges)
        self.assertEqual(order[0], "a")
        self.assertEqual(order[-1], "d")

    def test_isolated_nodes_mixed_with_edges(self):
        nodes = ["solo", "a", "b", "other"]
        edges = [("b", "a")]
        order = self.assertValid(nodes, edges)
        self.assertIn("solo", order)
        self.assertIn("other", order)

    def test_duplicate_edges_do_not_create_false_cycle(self):
        nodes = ["a", "b", "c"]
        edges = [("a", "b"), ("a", "b"), ("b", "c"), ("a", "b")]
        order = self.assertValid(nodes, edges)
        self.assertEqual(order, ["a", "b", "c"])

    def test_self_loop_raises(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            topological_order(["a"], [("a", "a")])

    def test_self_loop_among_other_nodes_raises(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            topological_order(["a", "b", "c"], [("a", "b"), ("c", "c")])

    def test_two_node_cycle_raises(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            topological_order(["a", "b"], [("a", "b"), ("b", "a")])

    def test_longer_cycle_raises(self):
        nodes = ["a", "b", "c", "d", "e"]
        edges = [("a", "b"), ("b", "c"), ("c", "d"), ("d", "b"), ("d", "e")]
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            topological_order(nodes, edges)

    def test_cycle_with_isolated_nodes_raises(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            topological_order(["free", "a", "b"], [("a", "b"), ("b", "a")])

    def test_accepts_tuples_and_lists_as_edges(self):
        nodes = ["a", "b", "c"]
        order = self.assertValid(nodes, [["a", "b"], ("b", "c")])
        self.assertEqual(order, ["a", "b", "c"])

    def test_does_not_mutate_inputs(self):
        nodes = ["a", "b", "c", "d"]
        edges = [("a", "b"), ("a", "b"), ("c", "d")]
        nodes_before = list(nodes)
        edges_before = list(edges)
        topological_order(nodes, edges)
        self.assertEqual(nodes, nodes_before)
        self.assertEqual(edges, edges_before)

    def test_does_not_mutate_inputs_on_cycle(self):
        nodes = ["a", "b"]
        edges = [("a", "b"), ("b", "a")]
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            topological_order(nodes, edges)
        self.assertEqual(nodes, ["a", "b"])
        self.assertEqual(edges, [("a", "b"), ("b", "a")])

    def test_large_chain(self):
        n = 5000
        nodes = [str(i) for i in range(n)]
        edges = [(str(i), str(i + 1)) for i in range(n - 1)]
        order = self.assertValid(list(reversed(nodes)), edges)
        self.assertEqual(order, nodes)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

        self.assertEqual(topological_order(nodes, edges), ["a", "b", "c"])

    def test_diamond(self):
        nodes = ["d", "c", "b", "a"]
        edges = [("a", "b"), ("a", "c"), ("b", "d"), ("c", "d")]

        self.conn = sqlite3.connect(":memory:")
        self.conn.execute("CREATE TABLE users (id INTEGER, name TEXT)")
        rows = [
            (1, "alice"),
            (2, "al_ice"),
            (3, "al%ice"),
            (4, "al\\ice"),
            (5, "alan"),
            (6, "bob"),
            (7, "alan"),
        ]
        self.conn.executemany("INSERT INTO users VALUES (?, ?)", rows)

    def tearDown(self):
        self.conn.close()

    def test_wildcards_match_literally(self):
        self.assertEqual(search(self.conn, "al_", 10), [(2, "al_ice")])
        self.assertEqual(search(self.conn, "al%", 10), [(3, "al%ice")])
        self.assertEqual(search(self.conn, "al\\", 10), [(4, "al\\ice")])

    def test_ordering_and_tie_break(self):
        self.assertEqual(
            search(self.conn, "al", 10),
            [(1, "alice"), (5, "alan"), (7, "alan"), (2, "al_ice"), (3, "al%ice"), (4, "al\\ice")][:0]
            or sorted([(1, "alice"), (5, "alan"), (7, "alan"), (2, "al_ice"), (3, "al%ice"), (4, "al\\ice")], key=lambda r: (r[1], r[0])),
        )

    def test_limit_clamped(self):
        self.assertEqual(len(search(self.conn, "", 0)), 1)
        self.assertEqual(len(search(self.conn, "", 1000)), 7)

    def test_sql_injection_is_inert(self):
        self.assertEqual(search(self.conn, "' OR '1'='1", 10), [])
        self.assertEqual(len(search(self.conn, "", 100)), 7)

    return conn

    def test_prefix_match_sorted_by_name_then_id(self):
        conn = make_db(["Bob", "Alice", "Alfred", "Ann"])
        self.assertEqual(search(conn, "Al", 10), [(3, "Alfred"), (2, "Alice")])

    def test_ties_ordered_by_id(self):
        conn = make_db(["Ann", "Ann", "Ann"])
        self.assertEqual(search(conn, "Ann", 10), [(1, "Ann"), (2, "Ann"), (3, "Ann")])

    def test_percent_is_literal(self):
        conn = make_db(["100%", "100 x", "1000"])
        self.assertEqual(search(conn, "100%", 10), [(1, "100%")])

import sqlite3
import sys
import unittest

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)), os.pardir, "src"))

from solution import search  # noqa: E402


ROWS = [
    (1, "alice"),
    (2, "alan"),
    (3, "al%ice"),
    (4, "a_b"),
    (5, "axb"),
    (6, "back\\slash"),
    (7, "backslash"),
    (8, "alice"),
    (9, "100%"),
    (10, "100x"),
]


class SearchTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.conn = sqlite3.connect(":memory:")
        self.conn.execute("CREATE TABLE users (id INTEGER, name TEXT)")
        self.conn.executemany("INSERT INTO users VALUES (?, ?)", ROWS)

    def tearDown(self):
        self.conn.close()

    def test_prefix_match_sorted_by_name_then_id(self):
        self.assertEqual(
            search(self.conn, "al", 100),
            [(3, "al%ice"), (2, "alan"), (1, "alice"), (8, "alice")],
        )

    def test_ties_on_name_are_ordered_by_id(self):
        self.assertEqual(search(self.conn, "alice", 1), [(1, "alice")])
        self.assertEqual(search(self.conn, "alice", 100), [(1, "alice"), (8, "alice")])

    def test_percent_in_prefix_is_literal(self):
        self.assertEqual(search(self.conn, "al%", 100), [(3, "al%ice")])
        self.assertEqual(search(self.conn, "100%", 100), [(9, "100%")])
        self.assertEqual(search(self.conn, "%", 100), [])

    def test_underscore_in_prefix_is_literal(self):
        self.assertEqual(search(self.conn, "a_", 100), [(4, "a_b")])

    def test_backslash_in_prefix_is_literal(self):
        self.assertEqual(search(self.conn, "back\\", 100), [(6, "back\\slash")])
        self.assertEqual(search(self.conn, "\\", 100), [])

    def test_sql_metacharacters_are_not_executed(self):
        self.assertEqual(search(self.conn, "' OR '1'='1", 100), [])
        self.assertEqual(search(self.conn, "x'; DROP TABLE users; --", 100), [])
        count = self.conn.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users").fetchone()[0]
        self.assertEqual(count, len(ROWS))

    def test_empty_prefix_matches_all(self):
        self.assertEqual(
            search(self.conn, "", 2),
            [(9, "100%"), (10, "100x")],
        )

    def test_limit_is_clamped_to_at_least_one(self):
        self.assertEqual(search(self.conn, "", 0), [(9, "100%")])
        self.assertEqual(search(self.conn, "", -5), [(9, "100%")])

    def test_limit_is_clamped_to_at_most_one_hundred(self):
        bulk = [(100 + i, "bulk") for i in range(120)]
        self.conn.executemany("INSERT INTO users VALUES (?, ?)", bulk)
        rows = search(self.conn, "bulk", 1000)
        self.assertEqual(len(rows), 100)
        self.assertEqual(rows[0], (100, "bulk"))
        self.assertEqual(rows[-1], (199, "bulk"))

    def test_rejects_bool_limit(self):
        for value in (True, False):
            with self.subTest(limit=value):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    search(self.conn, "", value)

    def test_rejects_non_integer_limit(self):
        for value in ("5", 5.0, None, [5]):
            with self.subTest(limit=value):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    search(self.conn, "", value)

    def test_rejects_non_string_prefix(self):
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            search(self.conn, None, 10)

    unittest.main()

import os
import sqlite3
import sys
import unittest

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "..", "src"))

from solution import search


def make_db(names):
    conn = sqlite3.connect(":memory:")
    conn.execute("CREATE TABLE users (id INTEGER, name TEXT)")
    conn.executemany(
        "INSERT INTO users (id, name) VALUES (?, ?)",
        list(enumerate(names, start=1)),
    )
    return conn


class SearchTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_prefix_match_sorted_by_name_then_id(self):
        conn = make_db(["bob", "alice", "al", "alice"])
        self.assertEqual(
            search(conn, "al", 10),
            [(3, "al"), (2, "alice"), (4, "alice")],
        )

    def test_ties_broken_by_id(self):
        conn = make_db(["same", "same", "same"])
        self.assertEqual(search(conn, "same", 10), [(1, "same"), (2, "same"), (3, "same")])

    def test_empty_prefix_matches_all(self):
        conn = make_db(["b", "a"])
        self.assertEqual(search(conn, "", 10), [(2, "a"), (1, "b")])

    def test_percent_is_literal(self):
        conn = make_db(["100% sure", "100 sure", "1000 sure"])
        self.assertEqual(search(conn, "100%", 10), [(1, "100% sure")])

    def test_underscore_is_literal(self):
        conn = make_db(["a_b", "axb", "ab"])
        self.assertEqual(search(conn, "a_", 10), [(1, "a_b")])

    def test_backslash_is_literal(self):
        conn = make_db(["a\\b", "axb"])
        self.assertEqual(search(conn, "a\\", 10), [(1, "a\\b")])

    def test_backslash_before_percent_is_literal(self):
        conn = make_db(["\\%x", "\\yx", "%x"])
        self.assertEqual(search(conn, "\\%", 10), [(1, "\\%x")])

    def test_trailing_backslash_does_not_break_query(self):
        conn = make_db(["abc"])
        self.assertEqual(search(conn, "abc\\", 10), [])

    def test_sql_injection_is_inert(self):
        conn = make_db(["alice", "bob"])
        self.assertEqual(search(conn, "x' OR '1'='1", 10), [])
        self.assertEqual(search(conn, "'; DROP TABLE users; --", 10), [])
        self.assertEqual(len(search(conn, "", 10)), 2)

    def test_limit_clamped_to_minimum_one(self):
        conn = make_db(["a", "b", "c"])
        self.assertEqual(len(search(conn, "", 0)), 1)
        self.assertEqual(len(search(conn, "", -5)), 1)

    def test_limit_clamped_to_maximum_100(self):
        conn = make_db([f"user{i:03d}" for i in range(150)])
        rows = search(conn, "user", 1000)
        self.assertEqual(len(rows), 100)
        self.assertEqual(rows[0], (1, "user000"))

class ReadPeopleTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_simple_rows_keep_order(self):
        self.assertEqual(
            read_people("name,age\nAnn,30\nBob,4\n"),
            [{"name": "Ann", "age": 30}, {"name": "Bob", "age": 4}],
        )

    def test_quoted_comma_stays_in_name(self):
        self.assertEqual(
            read_people('name,age\n"Doe, Jane",30\n'),
            [{"name": "Doe, Jane", "age": 30}],
        )

    def test_embedded_newlines_stay_in_name(self):
        self.assertEqual(
            read_people('name,age\n"Line1\nLine2",5\n"A\r\nB",6\n'),
            [{"name": "Line1\nLine2", "age": 5}, {"name": "A\r\nB", "age": 6}],
        )

    def test_escaped_quote_and_crlf_rows(self):
        self.assertEqual(
            read_people('name,age\r\n"He said ""hi""",1\r\n'),
            [{"name": 'He said "hi"', "age": 1}],
        )

    def test_empty_data_allowed(self):
        self.assertEqual(read_people("name,age\n"), [])
        self.assertEqual(read_people("name,age"), [])

    def test_age_bounds_inclusive(self):
        self.assertEqual(
            read_people("name,age\nA,0\nB,130\n"),
            [{"name": "A", "age": 0}, {"name": "B", "age": 130}],
        )

    def test_malformed_input_raises(self):
        cases = {
            "empty input": "",
            "different header": "name,years\nA,1\n",
            "swapped header": "age,name\n1,A\n",
            "extra header column": "name,age,extra\nA,1,x\n",
            "missing row column": "name,age\nJane\n",
            "extra row column": "name,age\nJane,30,x\n",
            "blank line in middle": "name,age\nJane,30\n\nBob,4\n",
            "unterminated quote": 'name,age\n"Jane,30\n',
            "text after closing quote": 'name,age\n"Jane"x,30\n',
            "negative age": "name,age\nA,-1\n",
            "age above 130": "name,age\nA,131\n",
            "decimal age": "name,age\nA,3.5\n",
            "signed age": "name,age\nA,+5\n",
            "spaced age": "name,age\nA, 30\n",
            "empty age": "name,age\nA,\n",
            "non-ascii digits": "name,age\nA,٣٠\n",
            "exponent age": "name,age\nA,1e2\n",
            "hex age": "name,age\nA,0x1F\n",
        }
        for label, text in cases.items():
            with self.subTest(label), self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                read_people(text)

import sys
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "src"))

from solution import read_people  # noqa: E402


class ReadPeopleTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_parses_rows_in_order(self):
        text = "name,age\nAlice,30\nBob,25\n"
        self.assertEqual(
            read_people(text),
            [{"name": "Alice", "age": 30}, {"name": "Bob", "age": 25}],
        )

    def test_header_only_yields_empty_list(self):
        self.assertEqual(read_people("name,age\n"), [])
        self.assertEqual(read_people("name,age"), [])

    def test_quoted_name_with_comma(self):
        text = 'name,age\n"Doe, Jane",41\n'
        self.assertEqual(read_people(text), [{"name": "Doe, Jane", "age": 41}])

    def test_quoted_name_with_embedded_newline(self):
        text = 'name,age\n"Line one\nLine two",7\nBob,8\n'
        self.assertEqual(
            read_people(text),
            [{"name": "Line one\nLine two", "age": 7}, {"name": "Bob", "age": 8}],
        )

    def test_quoted_name_with_embedded_crlf_and_escaped_quote(self):
        text = 'name,age\r\n"say ""hi""\r\nthere",9\r\n'
        self.assertEqual(
            read_people(text),
            [{"name": 'say "hi"\r\nthere', "age": 9}],
        )

    def test_crlf_line_endings(self):
        text = "name,age\r\nAlice,30\r\n"
        self.assertEqual(read_people(text), [{"name": "Alice", "age": 30}])

    def test_age_boundaries_accepted(self):
        text = "name,age\nA,0\nB,130\n"
        self.assertEqual(
            read_people(text),
            [{"name": "A", "age": 0}, {"name": "B", "age": 130}],
        )

    def test_leading_zeros_accepted(self):
        self.assertEqual(read_people("name,age\nA,007\n"), [{"name": "A", "age": 7}])

    def test_empty_input_raises(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            read_people("")

    def test_wrong_header_raises(self):
        for header in [
            "age,name\n",
            "Name,age\n",
            "name,Age\n",
            "name,age,extra\n",
            "name\n",
            " name,age\n",
            "person,years\n",
        ]:
            with self.subTest(header=header):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    read_people(header + "Alice,30\n")

    def test_missing_column_raises(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            read_people("name,age\nAlice\n")

    def test_extra_column_raises(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            read_people("name,age\nAlice,30,extra\n")

    def test_blank_line_between_rows_raises(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            read_people("name,age\nAlice,30\n\nBob,25\n")

    def test_unterminated_quote_raises(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            read_people('name,age\n"Alice,30\n')

    def test_text_after_closing_quote_raises(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            read_people('name,age\n"Alice"x,30\n')

    def test_invalid_age_raises(self):
        for age in [
            "",
            "-1",
            "+5",
            "1.5",
            "1e2",
            "0x1A",
            " 12",
            "12 ",
            "12a",
            "131",
            "٣٠",  # Arabic-Indic digits
            "²",  # superscript two
        ]:
            with self.subTest(age=age):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    read_people(f"name,age\nAlice,{age}\n")

    def test_error_in_later_row_raises(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            read_people("name,age\nAlice,30\nBob,200\n")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

import os
import sys
import time
import unittest
from datetime import datetime, timezone

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)), "..", "src"))

from solution import utc_day_start  # noqa: E402


class UtcDayStartTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_z_suffix(self):
        self.assertEqual(
            utc_day_start("2025-03-10T12:00:00Z"),
            datetime(2025, 3, 10, tzinfo=timezone.utc),
        )

    def test_positive_offset_moves_instant_to_previous_utc_day(self):
        result = utc_day_start("2025-01-01T00:30:00+02:00")
        self.assertEqual(result, datetime(2024, 12, 31, tzinfo=timezone.utc))

    def test_negative_offset_moves_instant_to_next_utc_day(self):
        result = utc_day_start("2025-01-01T23:30:00-02:00")
        self.assertEqual(result, datetime(2025, 1, 2, tzinfo=timezone.utc))

    def test_offset_that_keeps_the_same_utc_day(self):
        result = utc_day_start("2025-01-01T10:00:00-05:00")
        self.assertEqual(result, datetime(2025, 1, 1, tzinfo=timezone.utc))

    def test_exact_utc_midnight_is_its_own_day_start(self):
        result = utc_day_start("2025-01-01T00:00:00+00:00")
        self.assertEqual(result, datetime(2025, 1, 1, tzinfo=timezone.utc))

    def test_last_instant_of_day(self):
        result = utc_day_start("2025-01-01T23:59:59.999999Z")
        self.assertEqual(result, datetime(2025, 1, 1, tzinfo=timezone.utc))

    def test_fractional_seconds_with_offset(self):
        result = utc_day_start("2025-06-15T22:00:00.123456-05:00")
        self.assertEqual(result, datetime(2025, 6, 16, tzinfo=timezone.utc))

    def test_leap_day_from_utc(self):
        result = utc_day_start("2024-02-29T23:59:59Z")
        self.assertEqual(result, datetime(2024, 2, 29, tzinfo=timezone.utc))

    def test_offset_crossing_back_into_leap_day(self):
        result = utc_day_start("2024-03-01T01:00:00+02:00")
        self.assertEqual(result, datetime(2024, 2, 29, tzinfo=timezone.utc))

    def test_offset_crossing_forward_out_of_leap_day(self):
        result = utc_day_start("2024-02-29T23:00:00-01:00")
        self.assertEqual(result, datetime(2024, 3, 1, tzinfo=timezone.utc))

    def test_non_leap_year_february_end(self):
        result = utc_day_start("2025-02-28T20:00:00-05:00")
        self.assertEqual(result, datetime(2025, 3, 1, tzinfo=timezone.utc))

    def test_result_is_utc_aware_midnight(self):
        result = utc_day_start("2025-07-04T13:45:10+05:30")
        self.assertEqual(result, datetime(2025, 7, 4, tzinfo=timezone.utc))
        self.assertEqual(result.tzinfo, timezone.utc)
        self.assertEqual(result.utcoffset().total_seconds(), 0)
        self.assertEqual((result.hour, result.minute, result.second, result.microsecond), (0, 0, 0, 0))

    def test_naive_timestamp_is_rejected(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            utc_day_start("2025-01-01T00:30:00")

    def test_date_only_is_rejected(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            utc_day_start("2025-01-01")

    def test_invalid_strings_are_rejected(self):
        for text in [
            "",
            "not a timestamp",
            "2025-13-01T00:00:00Z",
            "2025-02-29T00:00:00Z",
            "2025-01-01T24:00:00Z",
            "2025-01-01TZ",
            "Z",
        ]:
            with self.subTest(text=text):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    utc_day_start(text)

    def test_non_string_is_rejected(self):
        for value in [None, 1735689600, datetime(2025, 1, 1, tzinfo=timezone.utc)]:
            with self.subTest(value=value):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    utc_day_start(value)

    def test_machine_timezone_is_ignored(self):
        if not hasattr(time, "tzset"):
            self.skipTest("time.tzset is not available on this platform")
        original = os.environ.get("TZ")
        try:
            os.environ["TZ"] = "XXX-14"
            time.tzset()
            result = utc_day_start("2025-01-01T00:30:00+02:00")
            self.assertEqual(result, datetime(2024, 12, 31, tzinfo=timezone.utc))
        finally:
            if original is None:
                del os.environ["TZ"]
            else:
                os.environ["TZ"] = original
            time.tzset()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

import codecs
from typing import Iterable


def decode_chunks(chunks: Iterable[bytes]) -> str:
    decoder = codecs.getincrementaldecoder("utf-8")(errors="strict")
    parts = [decoder.decode(chunk) for chunk in chunks]
    parts.append(decoder.decode(b"", final=True))
    return "".join(parts)

import os
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

from src.solution import resolve_upload


class ResolveUploadTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self._tmp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        base = Path(self._tmp.name)
        self.root = base / "root"
        self.sibling = base / "sibling"
        self.root.mkdir()
        self.sibling.mkdir()
        (self.root / "sub").mkdir()
        os.symlink(self.sibling, self.root / "link_out")
        os.symlink(self.root / "sub", self.root / "link_in")

    def tearDown(self):
        self._tmp.cleanup()

    def test_nested_nonexistent_path_is_allowed_and_not_created(self):
        target = resolve_upload(self.root, "a/b/new.txt")
        self.assertEqual(target, (self.root / "a/b/new.txt").resolve())
        self.assertFalse((self.root / "a").exists())

    def test_existing_symlink_inside_root_is_allowed(self):
        target = resolve_upload(self.root, "link_in/file.txt")
        self.assertEqual(target, (self.root / "sub" / "file.txt").resolve())

    def test_absolute_path_is_rejected(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            resolve_upload(self.root, str(self.root / "x.txt"))
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            resolve_upload(self.root, "/etc/passwd")

    def test_target_equal_to_root_is_rejected(self):
        for supplied in ["", ".", "sub/.."]:
            with self.subTest(supplied=supplied):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    resolve_upload(self.root, supplied)

    def test_traversal_to_sibling_is_rejected(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            resolve_upload(self.root, "../sibling/x.txt")
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            resolve_upload(self.root, "sub/../../sibling/x.txt")

    def test_symlink_pointing_outside_root_is_rejected(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            resolve_upload(self.root, "link_out/x.txt")
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            resolve_upload(self.root, "link_out")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

def resolve_upload(root, supplied):

    root = Path(root).resolve(strict=True)
    supplied_path = Path(supplied)

        self.tmp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()

        self.root = base / "uploads"
        self.root.mkdir()
        self.sibling = base / "uploads_evil"
        self.sibling.mkdir()
        self.outside = base / "secret.txt"
        self.outside.write_text("secret")

    def tearDown(self):
        self.tmp.cleanup()

    def test_nested_nonexistent_path_is_accepted_and_not_created(self):
        result = resolve_upload(self.root, "a/b/new.txt")
        self.assertEqual(result, self.root / "a" / "b" / "new.txt")
        self.assertFalse((self.root / "a").exists())

    def test_absolute_path_is_rejected(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            resolve_upload(self.root, str(self.outside))

    def test_root_itself_is_rejected(self):
        for supplied in (".", "", "sub/.."):
            with self.subTest(supplied=supplied), self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                resolve_upload(self.root, supplied)

    def test_traversal_is_rejected(self):
        for supplied in ("../secret.txt", "a/../../secret.txt"):
            with self.subTest(supplied=supplied), self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                resolve_upload(self.root, supplied)

    def test_sibling_with_shared_name_prefix_is_rejected(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            resolve_upload(self.root, "../uploads_evil/x.txt")

    def test_symlinked_directory_to_sibling_is_rejected(self):
        (self.root / "link").symlink_to(self.sibling, target_is_directory=True)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            resolve_upload(self.root, "link/x.txt")

    def test_symlinked_file_to_outside_is_rejected(self):
        (self.root / "f.txt").symlink_to(self.outside)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            resolve_upload(self.root, "f.txt")

    def test_dangling_symlink_to_outside_is_rejected(self):
        (self.root / "dangling").symlink_to(self.sibling / "missing.txt")
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            resolve_upload(self.root, "dangling")

    def test_symlink_staying_inside_root_is_accepted(self):
        (self.root / "real").mkdir()
        (self.root / "alias").symlink_to(self.root / "real", target_is_directory=True)
        self.assertEqual(
            resolve_upload(self.root, "alias/x.txt"),
            (self.root / "real" / "x.txt").resolve(),
        )

from pathlib import Path


def resolve_upload(root, supplied):
    """Return the resolved path for an untrusted relative upload path inside root.

    This is a point-in-time check; it does not protect against later symlink swaps.
    """
    base = Path(root).resolve(strict=True)
    relative = Path(supplied)
    if relative.is_absolute():
        raise ValueError(f"absolute path not allowed: {supplied!r}")
    target = (base / relative).resolve()
    if target == base:
        raise ValueError(f"path resolves to the upload root: {supplied!r}")
    if not target.is_relative_to(base):
        raise ValueError(f"path escapes upload root: {supplied!r}")
    return target

judge_overhead.note: Measurement overhead imposed by Driftproof, NOT a cost of running the skill. Excluded from every field above. Counted over every draw sent to the judge, each once: the usage its answered judge samples reported, at the frozen judge price. Retried attempts and samples that reported no usage are not in it.

notes.absolute_cost: Absolute per-call cost on a CLI surface includes a fixed harness preamble (observed ~25k input tokens on claude-cli, ~11k on codex) that we do not control. It is identical in the with-skill and baseline arms, so it cancels in the Δ figures — read the incremental columns, not the absolute ones.
notes.cache_pricing: Cached input tokens are costed at the list input rate (an over-estimate where caching is heavy); cached_tokens is recorded per call so a reader can recompute.
notes.latency: observed on subscription CLI surface, indicative

corpus: The morning light settled slowly over the hills beyond the old market town.
A narrow river runs past the mill, where the water turns a wooden wheel all day.
In late autumn the beech trees along the lane turn copper and then pale brown.
The harbour wall was built from grey stone carried down from the quarry by cart.
Swifts arrive each spring and spend most of their lives on the wing above the roofs.
The library on the square keeps a collection of maps drawn by hand two centuries ago.
A light rain fell through the afternoon, and the streets shone under the lamps.
Bakers in the valley still use a starter that has been kept alive for many years.
The lighthouse keeper once climbed the spiral stair every evening at dusk.
Wild thyme grows between the rocks on the southern slope of the ridge.
The railway reached the coast in the spring of a dry year, and the station is still in use.
Otters were seen again in the estuary after the water grew clean once more.
The clock tower chimes on the hour, and the sound carries across the fields.
A small orchard behind the farmhouse holds apples, pears and two old quince trees.
Fishing boats leave before dawn and return with the tide in the early afternoon.
The museum displays a loom that weavers in the district used for linen and wool.
Snow rarely settles on the coast, though the high moor is white for weeks each winter.
The bridge has seven arches, and the central one is wide enough for barges to pass.
Bees from the hives near the church gather nectar from clover and lime blossom.
On clear nights the stars over the moor are bright enough to cast faint shadows.
The market sells cheese, honey, wool and baskets woven from willow grown nearby.
Herons stand still in the shallows and wait for small fish to come within reach.
An old canal links the two towns, and its towpath is now a path for walkers.
The village hall hosts a choir on Thursdays and a dance on the first Saturday of the month.
Moss covers the north side of the stone walls that divide the upland pastures.
In summer the meadows are full of buttercups, ox-eye daisies and tall grasses.
The ferry crosses the sound twice a day when the weather is calm enough.
A row of cottages faces the green, each with a garden of roses and lavender.
The forest to the east was planted with oak and ash after the great storm.
Gulls trail the plough in spring, picking worms from the freshly turned soil.
The potter fires her kiln with wood, and the ash leaves a glaze of its own on the jars.
Evening brings a cool wind off the sea, and the smell of salt drifts inland.
